purpose: Hardware comparison using retained producer ownership for glasses eye-texture copying
build_method: Diagnostic APK replacement of the driver asset and SteamVR launcher helper; the existing Vulkan layer already supports producer leases and is unchanged. Zig 0.13.0 (Clang 18) cross-compiled the C++17 ARM64 Linux driver/presenter with target aarch64-linux-gnu.2.31, -O2 -fPIC -shared -fvisibility=hidden -pthread -Wl,-z,defs, Vulkan-Headers v1.3.296 and repository Wayland stubs/protocol. C++ runtime linked statically; DT_NEEDED: libwayland-client.so.0, libm.so.6, libpthread.so.0, libc.so.6, libdl.so.2. Android build-tools 35 aligned and signed with repository test key.
pre_install_validation: Linux CI passed all 21 launcher/producer tests, including real Vulkan completion and frozen-overwrite validation on Lavapipe (not skipped).
Linux presenter completion and lease tests, fence tracker, compositor submit, and semaphore layer regressions all passed.
ARM64 Linux driver and presenter lease test cross-compile successfully.
APK signer matches the prior diagnostic build. Only the driver and launcher helper assets differ, apart from root signature entries.
limitations: Not a full Gradle/native rebuild; APK label inherited from the donor.
Lavapipe validation does not establish Turnip/KGSL performance or sustained hardware smoothness.
Hardware comparison pending before installation. This uses the existing producer lease protocol; it does not implement a SteamVR sync-texture handle handshake.
